column3: at is unreadable: for an empty batch it is not read at all; for a non-empty one — the time of the first mark is unknown: in the background the batch stays, the grace is counted by observing an unchanged version of the list by the local monotonic clock, not by at; in the cleanup window nothing is deleted from it — the boundary «older than the mark» only by a readable at: the batch is removed by CAS by the version read, an output line «`<sub>`: batch dropped: mark time unknown (`<n>`)», a removed batch is not a failure, the window's code — by the whole window: 2 only if nothing is deleted in the whole window (N2 «Sweep window command»); the next mark — a new batch with at
